 By Fielding Buck | fbuck@scng.com PUBLISHED: November 13, 2026 at 12:21 PM PST | UPDATED: November 13, 2026 at 4:16 PM PST Getting your Trinity Audio player ready... Yaamava’ Resort & Casino near Highland will get a Martha Stewart makeover next week and the lifestyle superstar will be there for the debut.
 Martha’s Forest of Wonder, described in a news release as a resort-wide immersive holiday experience, will kick off Wednesday, Nov. 18, with an invitation-only tree lighting, according to a news release from the resort. It will be followed at 5:30 p.m. by a “Legends Dinner” and a Q&A in Yaamava’ Theater with Jay Leno, the “Tonight Show” veteran who is a spokesman for the resort.
 There are two ticket options. One includes a four-course VIP dinner with a menu by Stewart. The front rows of the theater will be set up for dining. The price is $1,038, according to the online broker axs.com . Available seats for the Q&A start at around $103 and are selling out.
 Martha’s Forest of Wonder will “transform Yaamava’ into a sparkling woodland retreat, immersing guests in a curated color palette of brass, cranberry, forest green, pearl white, sage green and snow,” the release said.
 Photo-op highlights will include a giant wreath framed by bears, a moss-covered woodland scene in the high-limit table games area and Martha’s Sleigh Ride in an enchanted birch forest scene.
 Yaamava’ has been marking its 40th anniversary with a year-long celebration and began hinting at a Martha Stewart appearance in social media several months ago. In May, the casino gave its Club Serrano loyalty members free copies of her 102nd book, “The Martha Way: Essential Principles for Mastering Home and Living.” And Stewart did a promo for her friend Snoop Dogg’s concert in the Yaamava’ Theater on July 24.
 The resort is at 777 San Manuel Blvd S, Highland, and includes several restaurants, a hotel tower and two parking structures.
 Information: yaamava.com
